localization_default_install_guide:
1. Download the localization archive using one of the mirrors above.
  2. Extract the archive.
  3. Copy the extracted files into the game's installation folder (replace files if asked).
  4. Launch the game — the localization should be applied. Some localizations let you pick the language in the game settings.
